text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The blue sea!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The scorching sun!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I thought that sort of 
refreshing brightness was the essence of 
youth. But—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's not the essence of it. In youth, 
everyone carries fierce dreams and 
conflicts."
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's precisely why it's so moving.
Yeah, that's exactly why it's so moving.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This summer, I want to step into that 
boldly. While strengthening my raw ability 
as well, of course—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to get more deeply involved with 
BNW! Clashing our principles and 
convictions against one another.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-saaan, Hayahide-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, where's Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Taishin is... unfortunately not 
feeling at her best. So she will be on a 
separate menu.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can't even run in races for a while...? 
Waaahhhhhh, I'm gonna be so looonelyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: No way... Then we can't push it, can we?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...It's lonely, but we can't just stand 
still. Even if we did, Taishin-san 
wouldn't be happy about it."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san, Hayahide-san, I might not be 
skilled enough yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm here! I might not be the most 
reassuring substitute for Taishin-san, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to be of help, and I want to learn. 
For the sake of a fruitful autumn.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fumu―― That helps, Royce.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Not just Taishin, but we've all 
been through a lot too, though...”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Things like what...? O-Oh, yes! Let's do 
our best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with BNW, now missing Narita 
Taishin, Royce and Royce dove headfirst 
into a brand-new summer.
